text: Maaɗun laatee tagu goo ɓurngu tiiɗude e majji kannji ɗiɗi, ko tawi no tiiɗi ka ɓerɗe mon. Pellet, Alla ko O ruttoowo on wano O fuddori on non, O wurnitay on wano O tagiri on non ka laawol aranol, aray bee sanndalɗiiɓe ka wi'a: "Ko hommbo artirta men e ngurndan ɓaawo mayde amen?" Maakan ɓe: "Artiray on On Taguɗo on ka laawol aranol ko aldaa e misal adiingal", aray ka ɓe dimmba ko'e maɓɓe ɗen hara ko ɓe jalnorɓe ko jaabiɗaa ɓe kon, ɓe wi'a ko ɓe woɗɗintinɓe: "Ko honnde tuma woni ngol ruttagol?!" Maakan ɓe: "no gasa ɗun ɓadike, kala ko woni arude haray woɗɗaa.
